title: The Conditional
subtitle: parlerei, parleresti, parlerebbe. Hypothetical, polite requests.
objectives: Apply the conditional in reading and composition.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.body: This lesson covers the conditional. Italian grammar builds on patterns you have already learned. Focus on recognizing forms in context before producing them.

sections.heading: From Italian literature
sections.body: Real examples from Dante, Petrarch, Boccaccio, Machiavelli, Leopardi, or Manzoni illustrate this grammatical point in living use.

items.prompt: What is the main function of the conditional?

sections.heading: Up next
sections.body: The next lesson continues building your command of Italian grammar and vocabulary.
